3. INSPECT STABILIZER BAR LINK
Move the ball joint arm in all directions. If the movement is not smooth and free, replace the stabilizer bar link.

INSTALLATION OF STABILIZER BAR

1. INSTALL STABILIZER BAR
(a) Install the stabilizer bar link to the stabilizer bar.

(b) Position the stabilizer bar and install the stabilizer bar bracket to the body.
Torque: 290 kg·cm (21 ft·lb, 28 N·m)

(c) Connect the stabilizer bar link to the No.1 lower suspension arm and torque the nut.
Torque: 360 kg·cm (26 ft·lb, 35 N·m)
